info.title: Skill Dating API
info.description:
The HTTP API behind Skill Dating, generated from the code: the routes, the Zod schemas the handlers validate with, the response types of `src/types/api.ts` and the error catalogue. The page-by-page guide is `docs/FRONTEND_CONTRACT.md`.

**Conventions.** JSON in, JSON out. Sign-in is a Clerk session token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>` or the `__session` cookie). Every failure is `{ "error": { "code", "message", "params?", "details?" } }`: branch on `code` (the catalogue is in `x-error-catalog`, with the status and the placeholders of each message). Lists take `limit` and `cursor` (an opaque string) and answer `nextCursor`; `page` still works. Creating routes honour an `Idempotency-Key` header. Routes that pay XP include a `rewards` envelope (`RewardsEnvelope`): level-ups, tier-ups, achievements, the streak. Read-heavy GETs send `Cache-Control: private, max-age=N` and an `ETag`; send `If-None-Match` and get `304`. Every response carries `X-Request-Id`. Rate limits are per person and per route (`x-rate-limit`); a limited call is `429 RATE_LIMITED` with `params.retryAfter`.

**The romance mode ships closed.** Its routes (tag `Romance (post-launch)`) answer `503 ROMANCE_PAUSED` until it is opened for the caller; the only one that works meanwhile is `/api/romance/interest`.

get.summary: The achievement catalogue with the caller’s standing in each
get.description: All 40 achievements in order with the caller's standing: `{ achievements: [{ slug, name, description, icon, category, xpReward, secret, masked, earned, earnedAt, progress: { current, target }, rarity, order }], earned, total }`. Not paged (the catalog is fixed). The six secret achievements are `masked` until earned: placeholder slug `secret-<order>`, no text, reward, progress or rarity. `rarity` is the share of users active in the last 30 days who have it (0 to 1, null until the nightly job has run).

304.description: The answer has not changed since the ETag in If-None-Match. No body.

get.summary: A person’s activity feed, newest first
get.description: A user's activity feed, newest first. Query: `page, cursor, limit(≤50), userId (default: the caller), type`. Your own feed is complete. Another user's feed shows entries with no project (achievements, team and hackathon milestones), entries on public projects, and entries on projects the caller is a member of. Response: `{ activity: [{ id, userId, type, title, description, link, metadata, createdAt, project }], nextCursor, pagination? }` Errors: `404` user not found or has blocked the caller.

post.summary: Take a moderation action on a person or on something they made
post.description: Auth: `ADMIN`/`MODERATOR`. Honours `Idempotency-Key`. Body: `{ action, targetType, targetId, reportId?, category, reason, noteToUser?, feature?, durationDays? }`. `action`: `WARN`, `HIDE_CONTENT`, `REMOVE_CONTENT`, `RESTRICT_FEATURE` (needs `feature`: `romance|messaging|posting`; `durationDays` optional, none means until lifted), `SUSPEND` (needs `durationDays`, 1 to 365), `BAN`, `APPROVE_MEDIA`. `targetType` as for reports, plus `MEDIA`; for an action on a person use `USER` and their id. `category` is a report reason (minus the correction). Resolves every open report about the same thing, writes an `AuditEvent` and notifies the person. Response `201`: `{ action }`. Errors: `400 MODERATION_ACTION_INVALID` (hiding a person, approving something that is not media), `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` (a missing feature or duration), `403 FORBIDDEN` (acting on yourself; a moderator acting on a staff acc

post.summary: Reverse a moderation action
post.description: Auth: `ADMIN`/`MODERATOR`. Body: `{ reason }`. Lifts what the action restricted and restores what it hid (removed text stays removed). Audited; the person is told. `404 MODERATION_ACTION_NOT_FOUND`; `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` when already reversed.

post.summary: Decide an appeal: uphold or overturn the action
post.description: Auth: `ADMIN`/`MODERATOR`, not the moderator who took the action (`403`). Body: `{ decision: UPHELD|OVERTURNED, note? }`. OVERTURNED reverses the action. Errors: `404 APPEAL_NOT_FOUND`, `409 APPEAL_ALREADY_DECIDED`.

get.summary: The audit trail, newest first
get.description: Auth: `ADMIN` only. Query: `actorId?, targetId?, targetType?, action?, limit` (50, at most 100), `cursor`. Newest first: `{ events: [{ id, userId, action, targetType, targetId, oldValue, newValue, createdAt }], nextCursor }` (addresses and user agents are not returned).

get.description: Admin. List (with `members`; `q`, `includeDisabled`, `limit`, `cursor`), create (`{ name, slug?, emailDomains[], city?, countryCode? }`; `409 CAMPUS_SLUG_TAKEN`), and change (`{ name?, emailDomains?, city?, countryCode?, disabled? }`; the slug never changes; `404 CAMPUS_NOT_FOUND`).

post.summary: Add a campus with its e-mail domains
post.description: Admin. List (with `members`; `q`, `includeDisabled`, `limit`, `cursor`), create (`{ name, slug?, emailDomains[], city?, countryCode? }`; `409 CAMPUS_SLUG_TAKEN`), and change (`{ name?, emailDomains?, city?, countryCode?, disabled? }`; the slug never changes; `404 CAMPUS_NOT_FOUND`).

patch.summary: Rename, move or close a campus to new members
patch.description: Admin. List (with `members`; `q`, `includeDisabled`, `limit`, `cursor`), create (`{ name, slug?, emailDomains[], city?, countryCode? }`; `409 CAMPUS_SLUG_TAKEN`), and change (`{ name?, emailDomains?, city?, countryCode?, disabled? }`; the slug never changes; `404 CAMPUS_NOT_FOUND`).

get.summary: List the feature flags
get.description: Auth: `ADMIN`. Flags ordered by key. Query: `limit(≤100, default 50), cursor`. Response: `{ flags: [{ key, description, enabled, rolloutPercent, allowUserIds, updatedById, createdAt, updatedAt }], nextCursor }`

post.summary: Create a feature flag
post.description: Auth: `ADMIN`. Body: `{ key, description?(≤300), enabled?(default false), rolloutPercent?(0-100, default 100), allowUserIds?(≤500) }`. `key` is 2 to 64 characters: lower-case letters, digits, `-`, `_` or `.`, starting with a letter. `201` with the flag; `409 FLAG_EXISTS`.

get.summary: Read one feature flag
get.description: Auth: `ADMIN`. `404 FLAG_NOT_FOUND`.

patch.summary: Change a feature flag (switch, rollout share, allowlist)
patch.description: Auth: `ADMIN`. Body (any of): `{ description?(nullable), enabled?, rolloutPercent?, allowUserIds? }`. The change reaches users immediately (the cached flag set is dropped, which on Redis reaches every instance) and is written to the audit log with the old and new values.

delete.description: Auth: `ADMIN`. Response: `{ success: true }`. Audited.

get.summary: List the fraud signals found by the nightly detection
get.description: Auth: `ADMIN`/`MODERATOR`. GET query: `status?` (`OPEN|CONFIRMED|DISMISSED`), `limit`, `cursor`: `{ signals: [{ id, type, score, memberIds, evidence, status, windowStart, windowEnd, reviewedById, reviewedAt, createdAt }], nextCursor }`. PATCH Body: `{ status: CONFIRMED|DISMISSED, note? }`: DISMISSED restores every weight the signal lowered. Audited. `404 FRAUD_SIGNAL_NOT_FOUND`.

patch.description: Auth: `ADMIN`/`MODERATOR`. GET query: `status?` (`OPEN|CONFIRMED|DISMISSED`), `limit`, `cursor`: `{ signals: [{ id, type, score, memberIds, evidence, status, windowStart, windowEnd, reviewedById, reviewedAt, createdAt }], nextCursor }`. PATCH Body: `{ status: CONFIRMED|DISMISSED, note? }`: DISMISSED restores every weight the signal lowered. Audited. `404 FRAUD_SIGNAL_NOT_FOUND`.

get.description: Admin. Campaign codes (or `?kind=PERSONAL`), with `uses`, `qualified` and `rejected`. Cursor paging (`limit`, `cursor`): `{ codes, nextCursor }`.

post.summary: Make a campaign invite code
post.description: Admin. Body: `{ label, code?, campusId?, maxUses?, expiresAt? }`. Makes a campaign code (a random one unless `code` is given: 4 to 32 letters and digits). `201 { code }`. `409 INVITE_CODE_TAKEN`, `404 CAMPUS_NOT_FOUND`.

patch.summary: Change or switch off an invite code
patch.description: Admin. Body: any of `label`, `maxUses` (or `null`), `expiresAt` (or `null`), `disabled`. A personal code can only be switched (`disabled`). `404 INVITE_NOT_FOUND`.

post.summary: Run one background job now and return what it returned

get.summary: The numbers of the nightly metrics job, with every definition
get.description: Query: `from`, `to` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, UTC; default the last 30 days that are over; at most 366 days), `keys` (comma separated; unknown keys are `400`). Response: `{ from, to, computedThrough, truncated, definitions: [{ key, label, group, unit, dimension?, definition }], rows: [{ day, key, dimension, value, detail }] }`. At most 50,000 rows.

get.summary: The metrics as CSV
get.description: The same query; Response: a CSV file `day,key,dimension,value,detail`.

get.summary: The moderation queue: open reports and appeals, most urgent first
get.description: Auth: `ADMIN`/`MODERATOR`. Query: `kind=reports|appeals` (default reports), `reason?`, `limit` (20, at most 50), `offset`. Reports: open (`PENDING`, `REVIEWING`), most urgent first (`priority`, then oldest). Appeals: pending, oldest first, with the action. Response: `{ kind, items[], nextOffset }`; each item has `kind: "REPORT"|"APPEAL"`.

get.summary: One report with its evidence snapshot
get.description: Auth: `ADMIN`/`MODERATOR`. The report with its context: `{ report, target: { asReported, now }, priorReports[], priorActions[] (with their appeal), restrictions[], risk: { subject, reporter } }`. Opening a `PENDING` report marks it `REVIEWING` (audited). `404 REPORT_NOT_FOUND`.

get.summary: Search people by name, username or e-mail (audited)
get.description: Auth: `ADMIN`/`MODERATOR`. Query: `q` (an id, a username, or a prefix; an e-mail address for admins only: `403` for a moderator), `limit` (10, at most 25). Response: `{ users: [{ id, username, name, role, createdAt, deletedAt, isEmailVerified, verificationLevel, organizationVerified, risk: { score, effectiveLevel }, restrictions[], email? }] }`; `email` for admins only. Every search is audited.

post.summary: Correct a locked date of birth
post.description: Auth: `ADMIN` only. Body: `{ birthDate: "YYYY-MM-DD", reason }` (`reason` 10 to 1000 characters, required; unknown keys are refused). Corrects a person's locked date of birth, whatever it was before (or was not), and clears a refusal for being under 16. The old and the new date and the reason go into the audit trail (`BIRTH_DATE_CORRECTED`); the response never carries a date: `{ id, ageBand: "MINOR"|"ADULT", isMinor, changed }`. A date that would put the person under 16 is not applied (`403 AGE_BELOW_MINIMUM`: a correction cannot admit a child; the account is dealt with through moderation). A correction to 16 or 17 clears the place down to a country. `404 USER_NOT_FOUND`.

put.description: Auth: `ADMIN` only, with a recent sign-in. Body: `{ plan: FREE|PRO|CREW_PRO|ORG, until?, reason }`: an entitlement override, written as the person's `Subscription` with provider `admin`. Audited with the old and the new plan.

get.summary: A person’s risk score and what it is made of
get.description: Auth: `ADMIN`/`MODERATOR`. GET: `{ userId, score, level, overrideLevel, effectiveLevel, factors, computedAt }`. PATCH Body: `{ level: LOW|ELEVATED|HIGH|null, reason }`: an override that wins over the computed level (null clears it). Audited (`RISK_OVERRIDDEN`).

patch.description: Auth: `ADMIN`/`MODERATOR`. GET: `{ userId, score, level, overrideLevel, effectiveLevel, factors, computedAt }`. PATCH Body: `{ level: LOW|ELEVATED|HIGH|null, reason }`: an override that wins over the computed level (null clears it). Audited (`RISK_OVERRIDDEN`).

patch.summary: Change a person’s role (not your own)
patch.description: Auth: `ADMIN` only, with a recent sign-in. Body: `{ role: USER|MODERATOR|ADMIN, reason }`. Not on yourself (`403`). Audited.

Auth: `ADMIN` only, with a session signed in within the last 10 minutes (`403 REAUTH_REQUIRED`). Body: `{ organizationVerified?, portfolioVerified?, identityVerified?, reason }` (at least one mark). The verified-organisation mark can only be granted here. The verification level follows the marks. Audited with the old and the new state.

get.summary: The caller’s appeals
get.description: POST honours `Idempotency-Key`; 10 an hour. Body: `{ actionId, body }` (10 to 5000 characters). The person an action is about, once, within 30 days; works while suspended or banned. Response `201`: `{ appeal }`. Errors: `404 MODERATION_ACTION_NOT_FOUND` (someone else's, or none), `409 APPEAL_EXISTS`, `409 APPEAL_NOT_ALLOWED` (a warning, the window closed, already reversed). GET: `{ appeals: [{ id, actionId, body, status, decisionNote, decidedAt, createdAt }] }`.

post.summary: Appeal a moderation action
post.description: POST honours `Idempotency-Key`; 10 an hour. Body: `{ actionId, body }` (10 to 5000 characters). The person an action is about, once, within 30 days; works while suspended or banned. Response `201`: `{ appeal }`. Errors: `404 MODERATION_ACTION_NOT_FOUND` (someone else's, or none), `409 APPEAL_EXISTS`, `409 APPEAL_NOT_ALLOWED` (a warning, the window closed, already reversed). GET: `{ appeals: [{ id, actionId, body, status, decisionNote, decidedAt, createdAt }] }`.

get.summary: The caller’s session: who they are, or that they are signed out
get.description: Auth: none (answers `null` when signed out). Compatibility for the frozen UI, which polls this path through `useSession()` in `src/lib/session-client.tsx`. Response: `{ user: { id, name, email, image, role }, expires }` with the local user id, or `null`. Temporary: remove it when the UI moves to Clerk's hooks.

get.summary: The people the caller has blocked
get.description: The caller's own block list, newest first. Query: `page, cursor, limit`. Response: `{ blocks: [{ id, createdAt, reason, user }], nextCursor, pagination? }`. The list shows only who the caller blocked, never who blocked the caller.

post.summary: Block a person
post.description: Blocks a user. One transaction: creates the block, deletes any connection between the pair, and withdraws pending team applications and invitations between them. Idempotent: blocking again returns `200` with the existing block. Body: `{ userId: string, reason?: string(≤500) }` Response `201` (`200` if it already existed): `{ block: { id, createdAt, reason, user }, severedConnections, withdrawnApplications, endedMatches }` Errors: `400` blocking yourself, `404` user not found.

delete.description: Removes the caller's block on that user. Severed connections and withdrawn applications are not restored.

get.summary: What people are building right now
get.description: Public feed (`isPublic: true`), without builds from users the caller has a block with. Query: `page, cursor, limit, hackathonId`.

put.summary: Say what the caller is building now
put.description: Full-replacement upsert of the caller's own `CurrentBuild` (one per user). An omitted field resets to its schema default, even on update. Body: `{ title, description?, status?, progress?(0-100), techStack?(≤20, each ≤50), teamSize?(1-20), maxTeamSize?(1-20), rolesNeeded?(≤20, each ≤50), hackathonId?, githubUrl?, demoUrl?, isPublic? }`

delete.summary: Clear what the caller is building now
delete.description: Deletes the caller's own `CurrentBuild`. `404` if none exists.

get.summary: The caller’s campus, a check in progress, and whether they can join one
get.description: Response: `{ campus, verifiedAt, pending, suggested, canJoin }`. `campus` is the verified one (`{ id, slug, name, city, countryCode }`) or `null`; `pending` is a verification in progress (`{ campusId, domain, expiresAt }`: the domain, never the address); `suggested` is the campus an invite code suggested; `canJoin` is false for a minor or an account with no date of birth.

delete.description: Leaves the campus. Response: `{ success: true, left }`. (While verified, `PATCH /api/users/me/profile` with a `campus` text answers `409 CAMPUS_IS_VERIFIED`; the text no longer places anyone on a board.)

post.summary: Start verifying a campus: mail a code to a college address
post.description: Body: `{ campusId, email }`. Mails a six-digit code (good for 15 minutes and 5 tries). Response: `{ sent: true, domain, expiresAt, expiresInMinutes }`. At most 5 a hour. Errors: `404 CAMPUS_NOT_FOUND`, `409 CAMPUS_CLOSED`, `400 MINOR_LOCATION_LIMITED`, `400 CAMPUS_EMAIL_INVALID` (`params.domains`: the domains that work), `409 CAMPUS_EMAIL_IN_USE`, `429 RATE_LIMITED`.

post.summary: Confirm the code and join the campus
post.description: Body: `{ code }` (six digits). Response: `{ campus: { id, slug, name } }`. The person is on the campus board and in its feed. Errors: `404 CAMPUS_VERIFICATION_NOT_FOUND`, `400 CAMPUS_CODE_INVALID` (`params.remaining`), `410 CAMPUS_CODE_EXPIRED` (also after the fifth wrong try), `409 CAMPUS_EMAIL_IN_USE`.

get.summary: Campuses that take members, with the domains to use
get.description: Query: `q` (every word must be in the name, slug or city), `countryCode`, `limit` (≤50). Response: `{ campuses: [{ id, slug, name, city, countryCode, emailDomains }] }`: the campuses that take members.

304.description: The answer has not changed since the ETag in If-None-Match. No body.

patch.description: Edit your comment within 15 minutes (`403 COMMENT_EDIT_WINDOW_CLOSED`, `params.minutes`) or soft-delete it (its author, the author of the post, or an admin). `404 COMMENT_NOT_FOUND` for anyone else's.

delete.description: Edit your comment within 15 minutes (`403 COMMENT_EDIT_WINDOW_CLOSED`, `params.minutes`) or soft-delete it (its author, the author of the post, or an admin). `404 COMMENT_NOT_FOUND` for anyone else's.

get.summary: The caller’s connections and requests
get.description: The caller's own connections (sent + received, or filtered). Query: `page, cursor, limit, status, direction ('sent'|'received')`.

post.summary: Send a connection request
post.description: Sends a typed connection request (`TEAMMATE|COLLABORATOR|MENTOR|FRIEND|NETWORK`; `DATING` is no longer accepted: the romance mode is separate). Checks both directions for a conflict — an existing `PENDING` or `ACCEPTED` row either way blocks a new request. Notifies the receiver. Body: `{ receiverId, type?, message? }` Errors: `400` self-connect, `404` receiver not found (also when the receiver has blocked the caller), `403` the caller has blocked the receiver, `400` already connected, `409` already pending.

patch.summary: Accept, decline or withdraw a connection request
patch.description: Auth: the connection's `receiverId` only — not the sender. Body: `{ status: 'ACCEPTED' | 'DECLINED' }` On `ACCEPTED`: atomically finds-or-creates the `DIRECT` conversation between the two users, adds both as members, records activity, notifies the sender and emits `CONNECTION_ACCEPTED` (10 XP to both people, once per connection, at most 5 a day each). Response: the connection plus the accepter's own `rewards` (the sender is told by notification). `400` if not currently `PENDING`.

200.description: ReviewConnectionResponse (the answer carries a RewardsEnvelope under `rewards`)

get.summary: The caller’s conversations, with unread counts
get.description: The caller's own conversations, most recently active first. Query: `page, cursor, limit, type (DIRECT|GROUP|PROJECT|TEAM|HACKATHON), search`. `search` matches (case-insensitively) the conversation name, its team/project/hackathon name, and the other members' name or username. Response: `{ conversations: [{ ...conversation, members, messages (latest one only), _count, unreadCount }], totalUnread, nextCursor, pagination? }`. `unreadCount` counts messages from other senders with no read row for the caller; `totalUnread` is their sum.

post.summary: Start a conversation
post.description: Creates a conversation (`DIRECT` requires exactly 1 `participantIds` entry, returns the existing one if a `DIRECT` conversation between the same two users already exists). Body: `{ type?: 'DIRECT' | 'GROUP', name?, participantIds(1-50) }`. Only `DIRECT` and `GROUP` can be created by a client; team, project and hackathon conversations are created with the thing they belong to, and binding one from here is not possible (those keys are stripped, and other `type` values are a `400`). Errors: `400` any participant does not exist; `404` the direct-conversation counterpart has blocked the caller; `403` the caller has blocked them.

get.summary: A conversation and its messages
get.description: Auth: conversation member only. Paginated messages (oldest first within the page), deleted messages masked (`content: null, isDeleted: true`) rather than omitted. Query: `page, cursor, limit(≤100), before (ISO datetime)`. The response's `nextCursor` leads to the next older page. Marks exactly the messages returned as read for the caller.

post.summary: Send a message
post.description: Auth: conversation member only. Sends a message and notifies other members; the message, the notifications and the conversation's activity stamp commit together. The first message ever sent in a direct conversation between two connected people emits `MESSAGE_SENT_FIRST_IN_CONNECTION` (5 XP to the sender, once per conversation, at most 5 a day). Response: the message plus the sender's `rewards`. Direct conversations are closed once either side blocks the other (`403` for the blocker, `404` for the blocked user); shared team, project and hackathon rooms stay open. Body: `{ content, type?, replyToId?, metadata? }`

201.description: SendMessageResponse (the answer carries a RewardsEnvelope under `rewards`)

post.summary: Mark a conversation read
post.description: Auth: conversation member only. Marks messages from other senders as read for the caller. Body (optional): `{ upToMessageId?: string }` — with it, only messages up to and including that one; without it (or with an empty body), everything. Response: `{ conversationId, readCount, unreadCount }` Errors: `400` `upToMessageId` is not in this conversation.

get.summary: Today: the caller’s numbers, what to do next, who to meet
get.description: Everything the dashboard page shows, through the same rules as every other endpoint. Blocked users and their teams never appear in recommendations. The same data is available to a server component as `getDashboardData(prisma, userId)` from `src/lib/dashboard.ts`. Response: `{ currentBuild, userProjects (active, ≤5), userTeams, hackathonParticipations, userQuests, recentActivities, xpEvents, userSkills, recommendedBuilders (with compatibility and commonSkills), recruitingTeams, upcomingHackathons }`

304.description: The answer has not changed since the ETag in If-None-Match. No body.

get.summary: Find builders, ranked by how well they fit the caller
get.description: One-to-one match candidates, ranked by real skill-compatibility score against a bounded recency-ordered pool. Blocked users (either direction) are never returned. Query: `page, cursor, limit, search, skills, location`. Response: `{ people: [{ ...user, compatibility }], pagination }`

304.description: The answer has not changed since the ETag in If-None-Match. No body.

post.summary: Pass on a drop
post.description: Passes on a drop: the person is not shown to the caller again for 30 days. Response: `{ id, status: "PASSED" }`; passing twice returns the same. `404 DROP_NOT_FOUND` for a drop that does not exist or is not the caller's; `409 DROP_NOT_PENDING` for one already sparked or expired.

get.summary: Today’s drops: the people picked for the caller, with why
get.description: The caller's daily drops for their own current date: `{ date, drops, hasProfile, paused, dropTimeLocal, nextDropAt }`. Each drop is `{ id, connectionType, score (0-100), reasons (≤3 lines), status (NEW|SPARKED|PASSED|EXPIRED), secondLook, expiresAt, candidate: { id, name, username, image, headline, builderRole, location, level, tier, skills (top 5), proof: { verifiedEvidence, shipped } } }`, best first. Someone who has been blocked either way since, or whose account is gone, is left out. The first read of a new drop counts one `drop_viewed`. `hasProfile: false` means the caller has not saved a matching profile (show the setup). `nextDropAt` is when the next drops arrive, to the hour (an hourly job makes them); `null` while paused or without a profile. Drops are made by the job `drops/generate`, not by this request, so it can be empty early in the day.

get.summary: The caller’s skill evidence
get.description: Query: `page, cursor, limit(≤50), userId (default: the caller), skillId`. Endorsement rows are not listed; each evidence item carries `endorsementCount` and `endorsedByMe`. Response: `{ evidence: [{ id, userId, skillId, type, title, description, url, verifiedAt, createdAt, skill, endorsementCount, endorsedByMe }], pagination }` Errors: `404` user not found or has blocked the caller.

post.summary: Add evidence for a skill
post.description: Creates evidence for the caller. Records activity and emits `EVIDENCE_ADDED` (20 XP once per piece of evidence, at most 3 a day, and `first-evidence`). Response: the evidence plus `rewards`. Body: `{ skillId, type: 'GITHUB_PROJECT' | 'PORTFOLIO' | 'CERTIFICATION' | 'CONTRIBUTION', title(≤200), url? (http/https, ≤2048), description?(≤2000) }` (unknown keys are rejected) Errors: `400` the caller has not added that skill, or already has 20 pieces of evidence on it.

delete.description: Auth: the evidence owner (`403` otherwise). Deleting evidence also removes the endorsements on it. Response: `{ success: true }`

post.summary: Endorse someone’s evidence
